title: video-title-wt: Layers never reflects selection; no way to animate properties
notes: Checklist sweep gate 4 fail: step 3 copy claims the title is 'seen three ways' including a Title row in Layers (~433), but steps only select timeline clips; #lrTitle/#lrArt/#lrL3 never get .sel. Gate 10 warn: property rows (Size/Weight, X/Y/W/H, Length) show no animate affordance and no dormant-property catalogue (D10). Shared root cause across all video walkthroughs: steps only pass a .clip id to data-select, and shared/components/walkthrough.js marks exactly one node and strips .sel from every .lrow, so the Layers rows naming the same clips never light up. agent-generate-wt line ~520 shows data-select on a .lrow working. Also D9 warn: the page never sets data-tl-summary, so the injected collapsed-timeline row names nothing; and the play button lacks aria-pressed. From sweep-every-clickthrough-page-for-checklist-conf.
